items.name: use-fx-delta-samples
items.title: useFxDeltaSamples
items.description: Evaluates an FX delta surface at supplied coordinates through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native FX delta-surface evaluation with complete immutable quote/coordinate/forward keys. Null means no sampling request. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; returns annualized Black decimal volatilities or native errors.

items.name: use-fx-strike-surface
items.title: useFxStrikeSurface
items.description: Materializes an FX delta surface as a strike-space volatility surface through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native models.volatility.materializeFxDeltaSurface with complete immutable quote/spot/rate keys. Null means no request. Spot is domestic per unit of foreign; rates are continuously compounded decimals, never defaulted. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; returns the canonical stored-surface JSON or native errors.

items.name: use-cube-samples
items.title: useCubeSamples
items.description: Evaluates a SABR volatility cube at supplied coordinates through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Checked native cube evaluation with complete SABR/forward/interpolation/coordinate/convention query keys. Null disables sampling. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; no local model calculation or clamping.

items.name: use-cube-slice
items.title: useCubeSlice
items.description: Materializes a fixed-tenor or fixed-expiry slice of a SABR volatility cube at explicit strikes through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native models.volatility.materializeCubeTenorSlice/ExpirySlice and their Normal variants with complete immutable cube/axis/value/strike/convention keys. Null means no request. Strikes are absolute in the stored forwards' rate units; off-node values are Rust-interpolated. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; returns the canonical slice JSON or native errors.

items.name: use-cube-smile
items.title: useCubeSmile
items.description: Evaluates the SABR smile of one volatility-cube node, its static-arbitrage check and an optional repair through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native VolCube paramsAt/forwardAt, SabrParameters.fromJson and SabrSmile generateSmile, validateNoArbitrage and repairArbitrage with complete immutable keys. The continuously compounded decimal rate is required and never defaulted; omitted repair passes run no repair. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; errors are unchanged.

items.name: fx-surface-chart
items.title: FX surface chart
items.description: FX volatility surface: raw quotes, natively evaluated Black volatilities and a Rust-materialized strike grid as heatmaps, tables and slices.
items.docs: Raw FX quotes and native evaluated Black volatility, sharing surface table/slices/selection/exports. Supply original coordinates with explicit quote/base forwards and an explicit color domain. Missing forwards show only raw quotes; no curve choice or local conversion occurs. The strike grid materializes the quotes natively (models.volatility.materializeFxDeltaSurface) from an editable spot (domestic per unit of foreign) and continuously compounded domestic and foreign decimal rates, seeded only from initialSpot, initialDomesticRate and initialForeignRate. Requires FinstackQueryProvider. Quote editing uses market-context-form and use-market-validator.

items.name: vol-cube-slice
items.title: Volatility cube slice
items.description: Rust-materialized fixed-tenor or fixed-expiry slice of a SABR volatility cube, plus one node's native SABR smile, arbitrage check and repair.
items.docs: Slices a canonical cube at explicit absolute strikes (initialStrikes, one editable field each, in the given order) through models.volatility.materializeCube{Tenor,Expiry}Slice[Normal], rendered by the shared surface view with an explicit color extent per convention. The node smile comes from SabrSmile at the selected expiry/tenor node: normal volatility when beta < 1e-4, Black otherwise, as the facade documents; the arbitrage check needs an explicit continuously compounded decimal rate (initialRate, never defaulted) and the repaired line appears only when repairIterations is supplied. Strike ordering and domain are validated natively. Requires FinstackQueryProvider.

items.name: vol-cube-explorer
items.title: Volatility cube explorer
items.description: Explores a volatility cube by strike and convention using natively evaluated samples, with an optional Rust-materialized slice and node smile.
items.docs: Checked native volatility cube exploration. Supply canonical cube state, initial absolute strike and explicit normal or Black/lognormal convention, plus color extents for both output units. Original SABR parameters, forwards and shifts remain separate from evaluated samples. Supplying slice (explicit initialStrikes, optional initialRate and repairIterations) adds vol-cube-slice. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; editing uses market-context-form and native validation.

items.name: transition-matrix-heatmap
items.title: Transition matrix heatmap
items.description: Display of a native rating transition matrix, its regularized generator and projected cumulative default probabilities, as heatmaps and a term-structure figure or as tables.
items.docs: Display-only view of the results returned by useMigrationMatrix (models.credit.migration.TransitionMatrix.fromLabeled) and useMigrationProjection (GeneratorMatrix.fromTransitionMatrix, then models.credit.migration.project per horizon). Labels and the default state come from the matrix's RatingScale. The transition and generator matrices are heatmaps (origin by destination, scale order); probabilities use the colour domain [0, 1] and the generator the extent of its intensities, centred on zero when the negative diagonal and positive off-diagonals straddle it. The generator's round-trip error and L1 regularization are stamped beside it; cumulative default probabilities are drawn per origin state against the requested horizons. A view control switches every section to tables. A projection error (for example a round-trip tolerance Rust rejects) is shown inline while the matrix stays visible. Values are decimals as Rust returned them; nothing is computed. Accepts matrix, loading, error, projection, projectionLoading, projectionError, initialView, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: merton-calculator
items.title: Merton calculator
items.description: Calculator of a native models.credit.MertonModel report: the generated MertonModel form or a KMV equity calibration, horizons and CDS terms, then the returned term structure, spreads, implied equity and master-scale grades.
items.docs: Edits a Merton structural-credit request: horizons, CDS maturity and recovery, and the model either with the schema form over the generated MertonModel contract (native validation through the caller's validate callback, usually useMertonModelValidator) or as a KMV equity calibration (equity value and volatility, short- and long-term debt, rate, payout, calibration maturity). Calculate passes the request to the caller (usually the useMertonReport request). The returned report is shown as Rust returned it: CDS par spread and implied equity value and volatility tiles, a term-structure table (default probability, distance to default, implied and debt spreads, master-scale grade and central PD per horizon) and the canonical model parameters with the KMV default point of an equity calibration. A measure Rust rejects for the model (such as the debt spread of a first-passage barrier) shows its native error beside the rest. Values are decimals with no units inferred. Accepts defaultRequest, validate, onSubmit, report, loading, error, formatValue and density props.

items.name: use-migration-matrix
items.title: useMigrationMatrix
items.description: Builds a native rating transition matrix from labelled rows through the WASM worker.
items.docs: models.credit.migration.TransitionMatrix.fromLabeled over the supplied labels (rows and columns share one order; the last label is the absorbing default state), rows and horizon in years, then toRows, defaultProbabilities, horizon and the labels and default state of the matrix's RatingScale. Every handle is freed, including the scale the getter returns. Rows that do not sum to one, a non-absorbing default row or a non-positive horizon return the native validation error unchanged. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-migration-projection
items.title: useMigrationProjection
items.description: Estimates a native generator from a labelled transition matrix and projects default probabilities to explicit horizons through the WASM worker.
items.docs: models.credit.migration.TransitionMatrix.fromLabeled, GeneratorMatrix.fromTransitionMatrix (an omitted roundTripTol stays unset so Rust applies its default) and models.credit.migration.project once per requested horizon. Returns the generator's rows, roundTripError and regularizationL1, and each projected matrix's horizon and default probabilities in request order. Every handle is freed. A round trip beyond the tolerance or an invalid horizon returns the native error unchanged. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-merton-report
items.title: useMertonReport
items.description: Builds a native models.credit.MertonModel report graded on the default PD master scale through the WASM worker.
items.docs: models.credit.MertonModel.fromJson of canonical MertonModel JSON, or MertonModel.kmvDefaultPoint(shortTermDebt, longTermDebt) then fromEquity with it as total debt; then defaultProbabilities over the horizons, distanceToDefault, impliedSpread(horizon, recovery) and debtSpread per horizon, cdsParSpread(maturity, recovery), impliedEquity(maturity), toJson, and models.credit.pd.MasterScale.defaultCalibration().mapPds of the default probabilities. A measure Rust rejects for the model keeps its native error beside the rest of the report. Both handles are freed. Keyed on the complete request and worker session; native errors are returned unchanged. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-merton-model-validator
items.title: useMertonModelValidator
items.description: Validates MertonModel JSON natively through the WASM worker and returns its canonical form.
items.docs: models.credit.MertonModel.fromJson then toJson; the handle is freed. Superseded revisions reject. Connect it to the merton-calculator validate prop. Requires the shared Finstack provider.
